title: Michael Burry Says Stocks Could Peak Within 9 Months — and He’s Betting Against the Nasdaq and Chip Stocks
key_facts: Burry wrote on his Cassandra Unchained Substack that he consolidated almost all bearish exposure into two bets.
He bought puts on the Nasdaq-100, expiring April 2027, and on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF, expiring June 2027.
He kept longer-dated puts on Palantir and Oracle and closed other bearish positions.
His forecast puts a possible market peak within nine months.
The semiconductor ETF is up more than 67% this year; Nvidia, TSMC and AMD make up 34.5% of it.
The article says the report does not give portfolio weights or premiums, so it cannot show he has become more bearish.
Nine months from October runs into July 2027, beyond both expiry dates.
quote_evidence: Earlier this week, Burry wrote on his Cassandra Unchained Substack that he consolidated almost all of his bearish exposure into just two investments: the Nasdaq-100 index and semiconductors.
However, the report doesn't provide the before-and-after portfolio weights, premiums paid, or comparable exposure figures needed to establish whether his overall wager increased.
why_it_matters_hint: Burry still expects a drop, but his options may expire before it comes.
